sources.text:
schema: work/contract@1
id: contract.commerce.entitlement
title: Premium entitlement contract
state: todo
activity: idle
owner: be
between:
  - commerce server
  - other features
surface:
  - isPremium(learner) returns true only when premiumUntil is later than current
    UTC time.
  - premiumUntil(learner) returns the stored UTC entitlement end or null when no
    entitlement exists.
guarantees:
  - Other features can read current Premium status without coupling to payment
    providers
  - Expired entitlement is inactive with no grace period
  - An active renewal extends from the current future entitlement end as
    proposed in Q-W2-5.
consumerObligations:
  - Pass the authenticated learner identity
  - enforce the returned status at the feature boundary
refs:
  - data.commerce.entitlement
requiresProof:
  - required: true
    command: npm --prefix be test -- --runInBand
    note: Scoped entitlement contract tests; remains todo until green.
change:
  rev: 2
  kind: revised
  at: 2026-10-28
  reason: Restore approved Premium questions, proof obligations and repository
    module owners.

﻿schema: work/ui-screen@1
id: ui.commerce.plans
title: Premium plans
state: todo
activity: idle
brand: product brand tokens
shell: app shell

surface: Authenticated plan selection

ui:
  - Show monthly Premium 229.000 ₫ and yearly Premium 2.290.000 ₫ (10 months value).
  - Explain included Premium access, term, renewal behavior, no automatic renewal, and current entitlement end when relevant.
  - Provide clear plan selection and continue action; show loading, unavailable, and already-Premium states.
direction: pending
assets: []
requiresProof: []
change: {rev: 1, kind: created, at: '2026-10-28', reason: 'Specify plan selection screen.'}
